definitions.explanation: A student who has transferred from one school to another. A common figure in Japanese school life and an extremely popular character type in anime, manga, and dramas.

examples.japanese: {転校生|てんこうせい}が{来|き}た。
クラスに{新|あたら}しい{転校生|てんこうせい}が{紹介|しょうかい}された。
examples.english: A new transfer student was introduced to the class.

examples.japanese: {転校生|てんこうせい}はなかなか{新|あたら}しい{学校|がっこう}に{馴染|なじ}めなかった。
examples.english: The transfer student had difficulty fitting in at the new school.

notes:
Composed of {転校|てんこう} (school transfer) + {生|せい} (student). Transfer students are a staple character type in Japanese fiction, often appearing as mysterious or exciting newcomers who disrupt the class dynamic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転校生|てんこうせい}が{来|く}る: a transfer student comes/arrives
- {転校生|てんこうせい}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome a transfer student
- {転校|てんこう}する: to transfer schools
- {転校|てんこう}{手続|てつづ}き: transfer procedures

RELATED WORDS:
- {転入生|てんにゅうせい}: incoming transfer student (more formal)
- {編入生|へんにゅうせい}: student admitted mid-year (college level)
- {留学生|りゅうがくせい}: international student
